content_sections.heading: About CCI Mines Geologist
content_sections.text: Cement Corporation of India Limited describes itself in the notice as a Central Government Public Sector Enterprise engaged in the manufacturing and marketing of cement, committed to becoming a sustainable cement company. The Mines Geologist will work at the Dillai Parbat Limestone Mines of its Bokajan Cement Factory in Karbi-Anglong, Assam, where CCI proposes to engage qualified and experienced professionals on a fixed-term contract basis.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: CCI asks candidates to apply offline using the prescribed form, which can be downloaded in Word/PDF format from the CCI website at www.cciltd.in/careers in the career section. The form must be filled in English, and candidates are encouraged to type and print it if possible. Applications are accepted only in the prescribed format, in hard copy by post or by email (scan copy); no other means or modes are accepted, and applications in any other format will be rejected. Download the prescribed application form from www.cciltd.in/careers (career section). Fill it in English after reading the eligibility criteria for the post. Affix a recent colour passport size photograph at the top right side of the form. Attach self-attested copies of the documents listed under Enclosures below. By post: put the application in a sealed A4 size envelope only, superscribed "Application for the post of" followed by the post name, and send it to DGM (HR), Cement Corporation of India Limited, Bokajan Cement Factory, Karbi-Anglong, Assam-782490. By email: send the scan copy to [email protected] / [email protected] . Make sure the application reaches on or before 10.12.2026 by 5:00 PM; applications received after the due date will not be considered. CCI is not responsible for any postal delay or loss/non-delivery of applications. Applications without supporting documents, incomplete applications, or those not fulfilling the prescribed criteria in any respect shall be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice advertises one post, Mines Geologist (Post Code 1), in the Mining discipline, reserved under the UR category. Reservation will be applicable as per Government of India guidelines. Qualification: Degree in M. Sc. Geology. Essential experience: More than 2 years post qualification experience of opencast Metalliferous Mines. Preference: Preference will be given to experience in the cement industry/Limestone Mines, considered an added advantage. Age limit: Upper age 35 years. Upper age limit and work experience are calculated as on 01.11.2026. Nationality: Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply. Pay: Consolidated emoluments of 42,500/ PM, negotiable. On the successful completion of 01 year, the candidate will be eligible for an annual increment in tune of 5%. Other benefits printed in the notice: IPD medical facility for self only during the contract, as per CCI rules; 20 (Twenty) days of leave per year, non-encashable but which can be accumulated if CCI extends the contract; Provident Fund as per the EPF & MP Act, 1952; T.A. governed by the Corporation's TA rules as applicable to (E-1) level employees; maternity leave as per Government of India Rules; and, if required, residential accommodation at Dillai Parbat Limestone mines township on nominal rent and electricity charges basis, for attending duties in shifts and during emergency requirement. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of the following must be enclosed with the application: Proof of Age: Matriculation certificate having date of birth. Qualification: All certificates (statutory requirements) and mark sheets from 10th, 12th, graduation and above. Experience: Experience certificate issued by the employer, with clear date of joining and relieving, supporting the experience given in the application form. EWS certificate as per DoPT guidelines. Aadhaar Card. PAN Card. A recent colour passport size photograph must be affixed at the top right side of the application form, and candidates must have a valid personal e-mail ID and mobile number kept active during the complete recruitment process.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is purely on the basis of Interview followed by document verification, and candidates must clear each stage, including the Medical Examination, before final selection and appointment. Candidates are required to appear for a Walk-in Interview at Bokajan Cement Factory, Karbi-Anglong, Assam-782490, on 18.12.2026 from 10.00 AM onwards, along with their original documents. Candidates who are unable to appear physically may opt for an online interview by submitting an application along with relevant documents; their interview will be conducted online through a link to be provided separately. The notice says the interview time will be communicated to candidates separately. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Candidates shortlisted after the physical/online interview must appear for document verification with their necessary documents, original educational certificates and two sets of photocopies of each document. Candidates whose documents are not found to be in order shall be rejected summarily. The Medical Examination is listed as one of the stages to be cleared before final selection and appointment. Final results will be published after completion of the interview process, and the candidature remains provisional, subject to verification of certificates/testimonials.
